patch_description:
Analysis of current approach:
- Current program uses 20 parameters (rz_pre, rz_post, ry_shared) with combined score 0.68
- Prior best used only 2 parameters (ry_shared, rz_shared) achieving combined score 0.72
- The current program adds circular entanglement (CZ 7→0) and splits RZ into pre/post, increasing parameter count without improving accuracy but degrading parameter_efficiency_mean (0.05 vs 0.07)
- Convergence is stable at 90 steps but generalization is flat (overfitting risk with more parameters on small dataset)

Key insight: The prior two-parameter approach was optimal because:
1. Shared parameters force the model to learn universal features
2. Minimal parameterization maximizes parameter efficiency metric
3. Linear chain entanglement (without wrap-around) matches data structure better

New strategy:
- Return to 2-3 parameter regime but add RX initialization layer as recommended
- Use single shared RX to kickstart state diversity before RY/RZ sandwich
- Keep linear CZ chain (better than circular for small data)
- Consolidate all RZ rotations to one shared parameter (post-entanglement)
- Result: 3 parameters (rx_init, ry_shared, rz_shared) vs current 20
- Expected: parameter_efficiency_mean ≈ 0.10 (333% improvement), maintain accuracy, improve generalization
